question: I.M. Vijayan, who was recommended for the Padma Shri award in June 2020, is a professional sportsperson of _______.
solution:
The correct option is __**Football.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** All India Football Federation (AIFF)** has decided to recommend** former Indian caption IM Vijayan **for the** Padma Shri award in June 2020,** which is the country’s** fourth-highest civilian award.**
 
• The 51-year-old former professional footballer and **the striker had scored 40 goals in 79 matches for India.​**

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e1/IM..Vijayan.jpg] 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• IM Vijayan was awarded the **Indian ‘Player of the Year’ in 1993, 1997, and 1999.**
 
• **He was also honoured with Arjuna Award in 2003.**
 
• **IM Vijayan** was** part of the victorious Indian football team** in the** 1999 South Asian Football Federation Cup.**
 
• He** scored one of the fastest international goals **in history during the game tournament, where he managed to find the back of the net in** just 12 seconds.**
 
• He also finished as a** top scorer with four goals in the Afro-Asian Games event that was held in India in 2003.**
 
• He formally** retired **from international football** after Afro-Asian Games in 2003.**
